texts: On day 495 of Year 2, Bevin Coombe scattered fresh ground feathers around the Stilllight Lantern in the evening.
The Stilllight Lantern was lit that night.
The Stilllight Lantern burned steadily that night.
Bevin Coombe saw a pale shape near the water of the Sunken Cove.
The shape turned away before the shape reached the Stilllight Lantern.
Bevin Coombe reported the sighting to the Council.
The Council held an emergency session the next afternoon.
The Council logged the report as a possible wraith near-miss.
The Council kept the doubled feather ration at the Stilllight Station for two months.
The Council told the keepers of the West Row to stay alert.
The Council judged that the feather warding had prevented a full emergence.

q1_issues.issue: "The Stilllight Lantern was lit that night" is parsed as an adjectival state (reified lit state plus flat copular atom), but a predicative participle is a verb by the instruction set's own test ("the worktop was laminated" IS a verb), so this should be the agentless passive of light.

(LocatedIn sk_water_1 sunken_cove) reads the of-genitive "the water of the Sunken Cove" as containment; LocatedIn is licensed only for a stated in/at/inside/within, and a relational of-phrase takes the ordinary genitive PartOf / Possession.

The non-veridical before-clause is asserted as fact - the reach event plus (Past sk_reach_1) at full strength claims the shape did reach the lantern, which "turned away before the shape reached the Stilllight Lantern" denies.
The log event carries no role atom for its direct object "the report" - the object surfaces only inside the sealed Theme term.

The "as a possible wraith near-miss" predicate is sealed as a Theme term, but sealing is licensed only for finite clausal complements of attitude verbs, embedded questions, imperatives and counterfactuals - not for a secondary predicate on an object.
The continuation copular "stay alert" drops "stay": the state is reified with the controller as Experiencer but no (Still sk_alert_1) tag records the continuation the verb states.

The matrix predicate "followed" is unrepresented - the strength-0 bundle denies a seeing event instead - and the noun "sighting" is re-lemmatized to the derived verb see, which the inflection-only (never derivation) rule bars.

The explicit quantifier "no" gets no (QuantifierPhrase ...) companion, which the negation rules make mandatory for every explicit quantifier word so that quantifier-none stays distinct from plain not-negation.

q2_gaps: non-veridical "before"-clause ("turned away before it reached X") - the Before relation parses both clauses as asserted eventualities, with no licensed way to record that the later one did not occur
classificatory secondary predicate "log / record / classify X as Y", with a "possible" hedge - no licensed encoding for a non-veridical as-phrase on an object
review.notes: Time-term propagation ("that night", and "the next afternoon" as Day 496 plus Before), the compound decompositions with noun modifiers correctly unexposed, the plural-modifier distribution rules, and the s12 attitude seal with its projected definite typing and in-seal past perfect all follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: The eventive-passive reading is live and the lit symbol will not unify with light events, but the instruction set does not force it: the lemmatization rule says to decide "by the word's function here, not its shape", and Focus particles supplies the counter-precedent (Member sk_annex_1 heated) for a predicative participle read as a state — and the parse's copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit is itself correctly executed, with no false or over-asserted atom.

"LocatedIn is containment ONLY - in / at / inside / within", and an of-phrase on a non-nominalized relational noun is the ordinary genitive of Possessive / genitive NP, so "the water of the Sunken Cove" licenses PartOf / Possession, never a containment head the sentence never worded.

The reaching never happened — the shape turned away before it — so (Member sk_reach_1 reach) (Agent ...) (Past sk_reach_1) at strength 1.0 asserts a false event, precisely the error Time warns of for anchor eventualities ("a (Past ...) there would assert an inspection that may never have happened").

Events requires "one role atom per participant", and "the report" is the logging clause's direct object, yet no role atom on sk_log_1 carries it — "what did the Council log?" binds the sealed proposition instead of the report.

It is true that sealing is enumerated for attitude complements, embedded questions, imperatives and counterfactuals and not for an as-phrase, but the reviewer's own q2 concedes this construction is uncovered, and sealing the classification rather than asserting it keeps the parse free of the false atom (Member sk_report_1 wraith_near_miss) — what is defective is displacing the object's own Theme slot (issue 3), not the non-assertion.

Resultatives prescribes (Still ...) on the reified state for an intransitive continuation copular ("the lodge remained / stayed empty"), and Still is an opaque presupposition tag rather than an occurrence claim, so omitting it silently drops "stay" and makes the directive read as "be alert".

The derivation half stands — "sighting" is a deverbal noun and (Member sk_see_2 see) is both a derivation and a synonym substitution, which "Inflection only - never derivation" and the go_out-is-not-fail rule bar, so the class must be sighting — but the "followed is unrepresented" half falls: Time's light-verb-over-event-noun rule (occurred / happened / took place) licenses putting the eventuality directly on the event-noun's own witness.

Negation (copular) makes the QuantifierPhrase companion "mandatory for every explicit quantifier word the rule or claim consumes" and singles out "no" so that quantifier-none stays distinct from plain not-negation; the claim quantifies a real range here (sighting x follow), so the companion is well-formed and owed.

gaps_confirmed: non-veridical "before"-clause ("turned away before the shape reached X"): the Before machinery reifies both clauses as asserted eventualities and offers no carrier for the later one's non-occurrence
classificatory secondary predicate with a hedge ("logged the report as a possible wraith near-miss"): no licensed encoding exists for a non-veridical as-phrase on an object
new_gaps: a continuation copular inside a control complement ("told the keepers to stay alert"): the prescribed shape is reified state + (Still ...) + the flat atom + tense, but a control complement takes no tense of its own and the flat copular atom would assert a state the directive does not claim, so only part of the prescribed bundle is emittable and the rule does not say which parts survive
adjudication.defect_summary: The of-genitive takes (PartOf sk_water_1 sunken_cove) (or Possession), never LocatedIn, which is licensed only for a stated in/at/inside/within; the non-veridical before-clause licenses NO asserted reach bundle at all - the compliant output leaves the reaching (and its Before endpoint) unasserted and records the gap, since nothing carries "it did not get that far"; the logging event must carry its direct object as (Theme sk_log_1 sk_report_1), with the "as a possible wraith near-miss" classification having no licensed carrier (the confirmed gap above); the reified alert state must take (Still sk_alert_1) to record "stay"; and the strength-0 no-sighting bundle must take the (QuantifierPhrase sighting follow "no") companion.
adjudication.notes: The two reviewer gaps bracket exactly the two confirmed defects that have no fully licensed fix, which is what makes them worth recording. The remainder of the parse is sound: "that night" / "the next afternoon" term propagation with its Before, the compound decompositions with noun modifiers unexposed, the fresh/ground per-member distribution rules, and the non-factive "judged" seal with its projected definite typing, sealed indefinite and in-seal past perfect.
